# The New York Times

> Global news, investigations, opinion, and service journalism from The New York Times across U.S. and international coverage.

The New York Times publishes breaking news, enterprise reporting, analysis, multimedia, and specialized products including Cooking, Games, Wirecutter, The Athletic, and Audio. Coverage spans politics, business, technology, science, health, arts, sports, and lifestyle.

## Main News
- [Home](https://www.nytimes.com): Front page for breaking news, top stories, video, and featured reporting.
- [Today’s Paper](https://www.nytimes.com/section/todayspaper): Digital edition of the daily newspaper organized by print sections.
- [Latest](https://www.nytimes.com/section/latest): Continuously updated stream of recent New York Times reporting.
- [Live](https://www.nytimes.com/live): Live briefings and rolling coverage of major developing stories.
- [Video](https://www.nytimes.com/video): News videos, documentaries, interviews, and visual investigations.
- [Podcasts](https://www.nytimes.com/column/podcasts): Podcast hub featuring news, culture, and narrative audio shows.

## U.S. and Politics
- [U.S.](https://www.nytimes.com/section/us): National news coverage from across the United States.
- [Politics](https://www.nytimes.com/section/politics): Reporting on elections, campaigns, Congress, the White House, and policy.
- [New York](https://www.nytimes.com/section/nyregion): News and features from New York City and the surrounding region.
- [Education](https://www.nytimes.com/section/education): Reporting on schools, colleges, policy, and student life.
- [Obituaries](https://www.nytimes.com/section/obituaries): Obituaries of notable figures with biographical reporting and context.

## World
- [World](https://www.nytimes.com/section/world): International news and analysis from correspondents around the globe.
- [Africa](https://www.nytimes.com/section/world/africa): Reporting on politics, conflict, climate, and society across Africa.
- [Americas](https://www.nytimes.com/section/world/americas): Coverage of Latin America, Canada, and regional developments.
- [Asia Pacific](https://www.nytimes.com/section/world/asia): News and analysis from Asia and the Pacific region.
- [Europe](https://www.nytimes.com/section/world/europe): Coverage of European politics, war, economics, and culture.
- [Middle East](https://www.nytimes.com/section/world/middleeast): Reporting on conflict, diplomacy, and society in the Middle East.

## Business and Technology
- [Business](https://www.nytimes.com/section/business): News on markets, companies, the economy, and finance.
- [DealBook](https://www.nytimes.com/section/business/dealbook): Analysis of business, policy, markets, and corporate power.
- [Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/section/technology): Reporting on tech companies, products, AI, and digital culture.
- [Media](https://www.nytimes.com/section/business/media): Coverage of journalism, entertainment business, and media companies.
- [Your Money](https://www.nytimes.com/section/your-money): Personal finance guidance on spending, saving, and financial decisions.
- [Economy](https://www.nytimes.com/news-event/economy): Coverage of economic trends, inflation, jobs, and policy.

## Science and Health
- [Health](https://www.nytimes.com/section/health): Reporting on medicine, public health, wellness, and research.
- [Science](https://www.nytimes.com/section/science): News about discoveries, research, and the natural world.
- [Climate](https://www.nytimes.com/section/climate): Coverage of climate change, energy, policy, and environmental impacts.
- [Weather](https://www.nytimes.com/section/weather): Forecasts, extreme weather coverage, and climate-related reporting.
- [Well](https://www.nytimes.com/section/well): Advice and features on fitness, mental health, relationships, and healthy living.

## Opinion and Analysis
- [Opinion](https://www.nytimes.com/section/opinion): Editorials, guest essays, columns, and commentary.
- [The Editorial Board](https://www.nytimes.com/spotlight/editorials): Institutional editorials from The Times’s editorial board.
- [Guest Essays](https://www.nytimes.com/column/guest-essays): Outside contributors writing on politics, culture, and public life.
- [Opinion Video](https://www.nytimes.com/section/opinion/video): Video essays and visual commentary from Opinion.
- [The Ezra Klein Show](https://www.nytimes.com/column/ezra-klein-podcast): Interviews and analysis on politics, ideas, and policy.

## Arts, Culture, and Style
- [Arts](https://www.nytimes.com/section/arts): Coverage of books, film, music, television, and visual arts.
- [Books](https://www.nytimes.com/section/books): Book reviews, literary news, interviews, and criticism.
- [Movies](https://www.nytimes.com/section/movies): Film reviews, industry coverage, trailers, and features.
- [Television](https://www.nytimes.com/section/arts/television): TV reviews, recaps, interviews, and industry reporting.
- [Music](https://www.nytimes.com/section/arts/music): Music criticism, artist profiles, and industry news.
- [Style](https://www.nytimes.com/section/style): Fashion, culture, social trends, and lifestyle reporting.
- [T Magazine](https://www.nytimes.com/section/t-magazine): Style, design, travel, and luxury culture magazine.

## Sports
- [Sports](https://www.nytimes.com/section/sports): General sports news, analysis, and feature reporting.
- [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic): Sports journalism covering teams, leagues, scores, and analysis.
- [College Sports](https://www.nytimes.com/section/sports/ncaafootball): Coverage of college athletics and major NCAA storylines.
- [Olympics](https://www.nytimes.com/spotlight/olympics): News, features, and analysis on Olympic competition and athletes.
- [Soccer](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/football): Football and soccer coverage from The Athletic.
- [Baseball](https://www.nytimes.com/section/sports/baseball): Reporting on MLB, players, teams, and postseason storylines.

## Lifestyle and Service
- [Food](https://www.nytimes.com/section/food): Food reporting, recipes, restaurant coverage, and cooking features.
- [Travel](https://www.nytimes.com/section/travel): Travel news, destination guides, and practical advice.
- [Real Estate](https://www.nytimes.com/section/realestate): Housing market coverage, home design, and buying or renting advice.
- [Magazine](https://www.nytimes.com/section/magazine): Long-form features, essays, and narrative journalism.
- [Parenting](https://www.nytimes.com/section/parenting): Advice and reporting for parents and families.
- [Fashion](https://www.nytimes.com/section/fashion): Fashion news, runway coverage, and style industry reporting.

## NYT Products
- [NYT Cooking](https://cooking.nytimes.com): Recipe database, cooking guides, and meal planning from NYT Cooking.
- [NYT Games](https://www.nytimes.com/crosswords): Crossword, Wordle, Connections, and other puzzle games.
- [Wirecutter](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter): Product reviews, buying guides, and recommendations tested by Wirecutter.
- [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic): Subscription sports coverage with reporting, analysis, and live updates.
- [Audio](https://www.nytimes.com/column/the-daily): Audio journalism including The Daily and other flagship shows.

## International and Language Editions
- [International](https://www.nytimes.com/international): International edition of The New York Times homepage.
- [Canada](https://www.nytimes.com/ca): Canada-focused edition with curated national and global coverage.
- [Español](https://www.nytimes.com/es): Spanish-language journalism and translated New York Times reporting.
- [中文](https://cn.nytimes.com): Chinese-language site with translated and original reporting.
